Joining this team provides the opportunity to work on highly visible projects with significant industry impact while collaborating alongside experienced professionals who are shaping the next generation of energy infrastructure. Implement project controls processes that improve visibility into cost, schedule, and execution performance. Lead risk identification, mitigation planning, and issue resolution activities throughout the project lifecycle. Provide clear, actionable project updates to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
